The all-wheel-drive system ensures confidence whether navigating city streets or venturing onto less-prepared surfaces.

Safety is integrated throughout this vehicle's design. The comprehensive airbag system, including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags, works alongside electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension to help protect occupants. The exterior parking camera provides visibility when reversing, while the blind spot detection system with rear cross-traffic alert offers additional awareness during lane changes and parking maneuvers.

The interior reflects premium comfort and convenience. The 10-way power driver's seat with lumbar support accommodates extended drives, while heated front seats provide welcome warmth during colder months. The power moonroof brings natural light and ventilation to the cabin, and the dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger can adjust comfort independently. The STARLINK 11.6" multimedia system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected throughout your journey.

Practical touches enhance daily usability. All-weather floor liners protect the interior, splash guards shield the exterior finish, and the rear seatback protector maintains the back seat condition. Heated exterior mirrors and heated wipers improve visibility in winter weather, demonstrating Subaru's attention to seasonal challenges. The split-folding rear seat and remote keyless entry add flexibility to your ownership experience.

This white Premium model represents a thoughtful investment in dependable transportation with the comfort and technology features that matter for modern driving. We invite you to visit our showroom to schedule a test drive and experience the Crosstrek Premium firsthand.

The universal garage door opener integrates seamlessly into your routine. Remote start lets you warm up or cool down the cabin before you step inside. The power liftgate opens with a simple button press, making loading groceries or luggage effortless, especially on rainy days. These features represent thoughtful engineering focused on reducing friction in your daily life.

The white exterior retains its fresh, clean appearance, while the interior remains pristine. LED fog lights and roof rails round out the exterior, and the auto-dimming mirror with compass and HomeLink, along with all-weather floor liners, add a couple of small conveniences that matter more than they seem to at first. This SUV is tailored for drivers who value sophistication in their daily routines, blending executive presence with day-to-day usability. The Tucson SEL's features—such as heated front seats, a power driver seat, and a sleek, ergonomic dashboard—cater to those who see luxury as more than just appearance. This effortlessness extends to every maneuver, making merging and overtaking feel seamless and unstrained—hallmarks of a truly refined SUV.

Blue Link Connected Car Service brings emergency communication capability, while auto high-beam headlights and heated mirrors enhance visibility in varying conditions. Smart connectivity is enabled by Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, bringing seamless access to your smartphone's functions. Cargo solutions like the cargo cover and package underscore versatility without sacrificing style, and details like the illuminated entry, remote keyless entry, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls enhance daily convenience and tactile pleasure.

Compared to premium alternatives like the Honda CR-V EX and Toyota RAV4 XLE, the Tucson SEL stands out for its sophisticated material choices and acoustic refinement. Discover the 2022 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid XLE, a stylish and reliable SUV designed for drivers who want efficiency without sacrificing features. With 161,492 miles on the odometer, this Silver Sky Metallic vehicle offers a sleek exterior complemented by a comfortable black interior. Powered by a 2.5-liter four-cylinder naturally aspirated engine and an electric motor, it delivers a combined 219 horsepower, ensuring responsive performance. The RAV4 Hybrid features a CVT with Sequential Shift Mode and all-wheel drive, making it well-suited for a variety of road conditions. Its impressive fuel economy, with 41 mpg in the city and 38 mpg on the highway, helps save money while reducing environmental impact. Inside, it comfortably seats five and comes equipped with modern amenities like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, enhancing connectivity on the go. Safety and convenience are prioritized with features such as adaptive cruise control, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, lane keep assist, push start, and keyless entry, making every drive safer and more enjoyable.

This used SUV combines practicality with advanced technology, offering a seamless driving experience. The 7-inch infotainment touchscreen provides easy access to connected in-car apps like Amazon Alexa, while voice-operated radio and hands-free phone calls add convenience. With six speakers and auxiliary USB input, entertainment options are plentiful, keeping passengers engaged. The vehicle’s adaptive cruise control, collision warning, cross traffic alert, and electronic messaging assistance further enhance safety and driver confidence. Whether navigating city streets or highway trips, the Toyota RAV4 Hybrid XLE delivers a balanced mix of comfort, connectivity, and performance, making it a smart choice for those looking to own a dependable, fuel-efficient SUV.

2022 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid Safety and Security Features

This SUV is equipped with essential safety features including a rear seat reminder, traffic sign recognition, and knee airbags for the driver. Its regenerative braking system helps maximize energy efficiency, while 4-wheel ABS ensures stable braking performance. Power door locks with anti-lockout and auto-locking functions add security, complemented by cornering brake control and an electronic parking brake with auto-off. These features work together to provide peace of mind during every journey.

2022 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid Entertainment and Technology Features

The RAV4 Hybrid XLE offers a 7-inch infotainment touchscreen with touch and voice-operated controls, making it easy to access music and apps. Compatibility with Toyota Connected Services allows for smart device app integration, while connected in-car apps like Amazon Alexa enhance connectivity. Hands-free calling and voice-activated radio add convenience, supported by six speakers and USB auxiliary input for versatile entertainment options. These features create a connected, enjoyable driving experience.

2022 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid Performance Features

This vehicle includes auto start/stop technology to improve fuel efficiency and features a nickel-metal hydride battery for its electric motor, providing reliable hybrid power. The on-demand all-wheel drive system ensures optimal traction and handling across various terrains. Designed for efficiency and performance, the RAV4 Hybrid XLE is built to deliver smooth, responsive driving with eco-friendly technology.

The 2.0L 16V DOHC engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive acceleration, achieving 22 mpg city and 28 mpg highway for balanced efficiency. Front-wheel drive and an electronic stability control system provide confident traction in various conditions.
